# Youth Legal Revolution

> A youth-oriented legal awareness initiative promoting constitutional literacy, legal education, responsible civic participation and evidence-based public accountability across India.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/): Mission, focus areas and introductory legal resources.
- [Organisational overview](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/overview.html): Vision, mission, objectives and operating approach.
- [Articles](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/blog): Plain-language explainers and research notes.
- [Legislation and implementation reviews](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/research): Source-based reviews identifying legal provisions, evidence, limitations and review dates.
- [Contact](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/contact.html): Official email and social profiles.
- [Terms of use](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/terms.html): Educational-use and legal-information terms.
- [Privacy information](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/privacy.html): Visitor and editor privacy information.

## Editorial limits
The website provides general legal education, not individual legal advice or representation. A review's classification as a possible legislative gap, ambiguity, or implementation concern is an editorial assessment, not an official finding. Readers should consult cited primary sources and qualified professionals for individual matters.
